title: Planner output contract v1 — FROZEN at M1
description: The only thing the planner is allowed to return. FROZEN: no field is ever removed after M1; only optional fields may be added. The overlay renderer consumes target + instruction and ignores the rest; confidence/reason exist for the debug overlay (M5) and for triage, not for rendering.

version.description: Contract version. Bump only by adding a new schema file, never by mutating this one.

intent.description: Task id resolved from the DSL, e.g. pay_bill. Must match a task file in assets/tasks/.

step.description: Step id within that task, e.g. amount. Must match a step id in the task DSL.

resource_id.description: Authoritative element identifier. The renderer resolves this against the live accessibility snapshot. Survives screen re-layout; index does not.

index.description: Index into the accessibility snapshot that produced this plan. -1 when unresolved. Debug/telemetry value only — never trusted for rendering, because it is invalid the moment the tree changes.

instruction.description: One short spoken instruction. Read aloud verbatim by Bulbul and shown on the card.

confidence.description: Planner self-report. Below CONFIDENCE_FLOOR the step engine falls back to deterministic ordering instead of trusting the plan.

reason.description: Short clause, under ~10 words. Deliberately capped: free-form rationale would reintroduce the reasoning-token latency we disable via reasoning_effort=None.
